proven: The accepted A7 frontend registered/enabled its bridge, stayed in the interactive operator session, received Ctrl+Space, and attempted remote dispatch.
Dispatch failed with HttpRequestException before any actionId was returned, so browser creation, clipboard staging, and foregrounding were never reached.
By diagnosis time the Stage-12 Serve route was absent/restored and both PowerShell and .NET GET /operator-bridge/v1/status reached Jupyter 404.
not_proven: Whether the route disappeared before the Q1 Ctrl+Space dispatches or the claim endpoint returned another non-success HTTP status at Q1 time.
diagnosis.defect_class: D4 outer orchestration lacks post-A7 backend liveness/route revalidation and human-loop route-loss observability.

post_a7_checks: SSH/backend process must still be alive after accepted A7 online startup returns.
GET /operator-bridge/v1/status must still be HTTP 200 valid Operator Bridge JSON.
active_loop_checks: While remote calibration remains alive, periodically require the Operator Bridge status route to remain reachable and valid.
Route loss fails visibly as D4_OPERATOR_BACKEND_ROUTE_LOST instead of leaving Ctrl+Space apparently dead.

postcondition: v1.9 orchestration repair candidate is source-validated but grants zero live authority. Windows v1.8 runtime cleanup, frozen-review exact-head validation, and fresh one-shot approval are required before any live retry.
